entities.summary: Maravillas Inmaculada Abadía Jover is a Spanish politician of the People's Party who was elected member of the European Parliament in 2024. She served as general secretary of the Alcantarilla City Council until her election, and was previously auditor of Dolores.

entities.summary: Maravillas Inmaculada Abadía Jover is a Spanish politician of the People's Party who was elected member of the European Parliament in 2024. She served as general secretary of the Alcantarilla City Council until her election, and was previously auditor of Dolores.
